info.statement: In {location}, the total population was {value}.

info.long_name: Lower bound of the rate of EMS patient encounters for alcohol-related emergencies per 100,000 population
info.short_description: Lower bound of the alcohol-related EMS encounter rate range for this county.
info.long_description: Alcohol-related EMS encounter rates are reported only as a range, never as a single point value. This is the numeric lower bound of that range. The `time` value in the standard data is the last date of this period (2025-07-31).
info.statement: In {location}, the alcohol-related EMS encounter rate fell between {value} and {alcohol_ems_rate_high} per 100,000 population.

info.statement: In {location}, the alcohol-related EMS encounter rate fell between {alcohol_ems_rate_low} and {value} per 100,000 population.

info.long_name: Mean 10-year risk of heart attack and stroke (ASCVD) for people aged 40-70
info.short_description: Mean 10-year ASCVD risk score (percent) among Veradigm patients in this area.
info.long_description: Mean 10-year Atherosclerotic Cardiovascular Disease (ASCVD) risk score, in percent, among Veradigm EHR patients with all data elements needed to calculate the score. Reported by 3-digit ZIP (ZCTA3) and nationally, overall and by age group (40-49, 50-59, 60-69, 70+), race, and sex. Stratum rows with no observations are omitted. The source stores the value as a proportion; it is multiplied by 100 here. Time period represented: 01/01/2022 – 08/31/2025. The `time` value in the standard data is the last date of this period (2025-08-31).
info.statement: In {location}, the mean 10-year ASCVD risk was {value}%.

info.long_name: Number of patients contributing to the mean ASCVD risk
info.short_description: Number of patients whose risk score contributes to the mean in this row.
info.long_description: Number of Veradigm patients (observations) behind the mean 10-year ASCVD risk in the same row. Provided for context on precision; small counts mean less stable means. Time period represented: 01/01/2022 – 08/31/2025. The `time` value in the standard data is the last date of this period (2025-08-31).
info.statement: In {location}, the mean ASCVD risk was based on {value} patients.
